cf.intro.lede.a: You describe a team member’s situation and the AI generates a
cf.intro.title: Prepare a development conversation
cf.q.alineacion.ayuda: The best development plans are the ones where both the team member and the team win. When there’s tension, name it.
cf.q.alineacion.placeholder: E.g. Fully aligned, we need that profile. / There’s tension: if they grow in the direction they want, we lose their current expertise.
cf.q.alineacion.pregunta: How aligned is their wish to grow with the business’s needs? Does the team benefit from this move?
cf.q.aspiracion.ayuda: There’s a difference between what the team member expressed and what the leader infers. Both are valid but call for different conversations.
cf.q.aspiracion.placeholder: E.g. They told me they want to lead a team in 2 years. / I think they want to move into product, although they haven’t said so explicitly.
cf.q.aspiracion.pregunta: Where does this person want to grow or move? Did they say so clearly, or are you inferring it?
cf.q.brechaActual.ayuda: “Lacks leadership” is too vague. Which concrete behaviors aren’t showing up yet?
cf.q.brechaActual.placeholder: E.g. They’re technically very solid and clients value them a lot. They lack executive communication and don’t make decisions without checking with someone.
cf.q.brechaActual.pregunta: What are their clearest strengths? And which skills or behaviors are missing for the next level?
cf.q.contexto.ayuda: Timing and context reveal the root cause better than the symptom itself.
cf.q.contexto.placeholder: E.g. It started 3 months ago, around the PM change. / There’s no clear event; it was gradual over the year.
cf.q.contexto.pregunta: Since when have you noticed this change? Was there an event, organizational change or situation before it?
cf.q.conversaciones.ayuda: This helps calibrate the next conversation and avoid repeating what didn’t work.
cf.q.conversaciones.placeholder: E.g. We had a 1:1 where I pointed out the missed goals and they got defensive. / I haven’t talked to them yet; I don’t know how to approach it.
cf.q.conversaciones.pregunta: What conversations have you already had with this person about it? How did they respond? What worked or didn’t?
cf.q.objetivo.ayuda: Defining success before the conversation completely changes how you approach it.
cf.q.objetivo.placeholder: E.g. I want them back at their previous level and able to sustain it. / I need to know whether there’s a place for this person on the team or whether it’s time for a harder conversation.
cf.q.objetivo.pregunta: What concrete result do you want from this process? What would success look like to you in 30–60 days?
cf.q.observacion.ayuda: The more specific, the more accurate the diagnosis. Observable facts, not interpretations.
cf.q.observacion.placeholder: E.g. In the last 2 sprints they missed the agreed goals. They take part less in meetings and two colleagues told me about friction with them.
cf.q.observacion.pregunta: Which specific behaviors or results are worrying you? Describe exactly what is happening.
cf.q.oportunidades.ayuda: If there are no real opportunities, the development plan will frustrate more than motivate. Better to know now.
cf.q.oportunidades.placeholder: E.g. A tech lead role opens in Q3. / There’s no clear role, but they could lead cross-team projects. / There’s more room in another area.
cf.q.oportunidades.pregunta: What concrete opportunities exist on your team or in the company for this growth path?

privacy.s1.1: You don’t need an account or to sign up. We don’t ask for your name, email or phone number.
privacy.s1.2: What you write and the documents you upload are processed to provide the service, and we don’t store them on our servers.
privacy.s1.3: Your progress is saved only in your browser, and you can delete it whenever you want.
privacy.s1.4: To generate the answers we use an artificial intelligence provider (Google), which receives the content of the conversation.
privacy.s1.5: Bivio is a reflection tool: it does not replace psychological, medical or legal advice.
privacy.s1.title: In a nutshell
privacy.s2.body: The service is provided by Rubika Tech SRL, Argentine tax ID (CUIT) [number], with its address at [address] (“Rubika Tech”, “we”). For any question about your data, write to us at [privacy contact email].

privacy.s3.a.rest: and, if you upload them, your CV and/or your LinkedIn profile exported as a PDF. They are used only to generate the questions, readings and reports of your session. We recommend not including sensitive data (health, union membership, religion, etc.) or identifiable data about third parties.
privacy.s3.a.strong: What you write in the conversation
privacy.s3.b.rest: : IP address and browser data, used to prevent abuse (request limits) and to operate the service. In our logs the IP is stored in transformed form, not in clear text, and never together with the content of your conversation.
privacy.s3.c.rest: (for example, how many people complete each stage), with no cookies and without identifying you, to improve the product.
privacy.s3.d.rest: , if enabled: technical information about the error, without the content of your conversation or your documents.
privacy.s3.title: What data we process and why
privacy.s4.g.rest: : processes the content of the conversation and the documents to generate the answers, under its terms for paid API services. If you ask about market data (salaries, demand, training costs), the coach runs a web search with a generic query that doesn’t include your personal data, and shows you the sources. [To be confirmed with the legal team: current data retention and use conditions of the contracted plan.]
privacy.s4.intro: We do not sell or transfer your data. To provide the service we work with these providers:
privacy.s4.outside: Some of these providers process data outside Argentina. [Detail the applicable international transfer safeguards.]
privacy.s4.title: Who we share it with
privacy.s4.v.rest: : hosts the site and the servers, and provides the anonymous metrics.
privacy.s5.body: Your processes (conversation, summaries, report and commitments) are saved in your browser’s local storage, not on our servers. They are deleted when you click “Delete this process” or “Delete all my processes” or when you clear the site’s data in your browser. If you use a shared computer, we recommend deleting them when you finish. If you create an account, your report and commitments are stored with our database provider until you remove them or delete your account from your account menu in Bivio; deleting the account also deletes your reports and pending reminders. [Define with the legal team the retention period for inactive account data.]
privacy.s5.title: Where it is stored and for how long
privacy.s6.body: You can ask us for access, rectification, updating or deletion of your personal data by writing to [privacy contact email]. Without an account, we don’t store your conversation on servers and we generally have no data about you linked to your identity. With an account, we store your email, your report and your commitments: from your account menu you can download everything we have (“Download my data”) and delete your account and data (“Delete my account and saved data”) without asking us. The Agency for Access to Public Information, as the Supervisory Authority of Argentine Law No. 25,326, is empowered to handle complaints and claims from people whose rights are affected by non-compliance with the personal data protection rules in force.
privacy.s6.title: Your rights
privacy.s7.1: Bivio supports a process of reflection about your career. The conclusions and decisions are yours: the tool does not decide for you or assess your worth as a professional.
privacy.s7.2: It is not a mental-health, medical or legal service. If you are going through mistreatment, harassment or danger, seek professional help; in an emergency, call 911.
privacy.s7.3: The answers are generated by artificial intelligence and may contain errors.
privacy.s7.4: The service is intended for people aged 18 or over.
privacy.s7.5: Do not use the service to upload information about other people without their consent.

privacy.s3.e.strong: Your account (only if you choose to create one)
privacy.s3.e.rest: : your email and, if you choose to save them, your report and commitments, along with the check-in reminder you ask for. The conversation is never saved. They are used only so you can see them from another device and to send you, once, the reminder you asked for. If someone manages your access, a record of those actions (account creation, activation, deactivation or deletion) is kept with your email. [Define with the legal team how long this record is kept.]

eval.section.body: Create self-evaluations with AI help and assign them by email, or evaluate yourself. Each person answers with concrete examples and gets a report.
privacy.s3.f.strong: Performance evaluations (only if you use this feature)
privacy.s3.f.rest: : the content of the evaluation (competencies and questions), your answers (level and examples), the generated report, the 1-to-5 score and comments that whoever created the evaluation gave each competency, and the email of whoever created it and whoever answers. An assigned evaluation is seen by the person answering and by whoever created it (the latter only once the person submits it); one you create for yourself is only yours, unless you decide to share it with another account (read-only, up to 5 people, and you can stop sharing anytime). Don’t use names or personal data of third parties in the texts, and don’t include sensitive data. Bivio doesn’t score or make decisions about people: the decision is always human. [Define with the legal team each party’s role (whoever creates the evaluation and Rubika Tech) and the retention period.]
